result.title: Stein Variational Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Score-Guided Particles for Multivariate Return Distributions
result.summary: Decisions that weigh several reward signals against each other require the joint distribution of the return vector. Categorical critics scale exponentially in the reward dimension, and quantiles have no canonical multivariate analogue. Multivariate distributional critics therefore represent each return distribution by M equal-weight particles trained with a discrepancy loss. Beyond their atoms, the particles provide no sampler and cannot resolve events rarer than 1/M. We propose Stein variational distributional RL (SVDRL). Its critic outputs Stein particles, which Stein variational gradient descent transports along a learned score field of the distributional Bellman target. We learn this field by bootstrapped denoising score matching across noise levels and tie it across the Bellman recursion by a consistency loss, which we prove is a non-expansive temporal-difference scheme in score space. The same field certifies the particles. Its reverse-diffusion sampler satisfies a supremal Wasserstein policy-evaluation bound that holds for bounded, possibly multimodal returns. The Stein particles inherit this bound up to a gap that we measure without ground truth, and the sampler answers tail-risk queries below the particle resolution at any sample size. Empirically, SVDRL is more accurate on rare events than particle critics with the same number of particles, and on par on MuJoCo continuous control.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SVDRL：用 Stein 粒子表示多变量回报分布，沿学习到的 score 场输运粒子，以自举去噪 score matching 加一致性损失训练，并用反向扩散采样器回答低于粒子分辨率的尾部风险查询。
AI.relevance_reason: 属 RL 分布建模，与视觉推理主线无直接关系；其粒子沿学习 score 场的迭代输运与跨 Bellman 递归的一致性损失，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代生成与轨迹级监督提供可核查的方法线索。
